integrity: Analytical derivation of potential and complete two-color equilibrium criterion; finite direct enumerations check 16 cases and do not prove the general theorem. A regular-graph potential theorem and a specialized bipartite case were considered prior coverage, not claimed new.
scientific_limitations: Exactly one vacancy, complete multipartite graph with at least three nonempty parts, fractional unlike-neighbor utility; exact potential any finite types, equilibrium classification only binary types; no result for arbitrary graphs or multiple vacancies.
title: Exact potential and reentrant equilibrium census for one-vacancy multipartite diversity jumps
